item.title: Biggest Takeaways From Lil Baby’s New Album ‘FRESH’
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Lil Baby is back to remind the world that he’s far from finished. As conversation began about whether the Atlanta rapper was starting to lose his grip on the rap game, Wham made it clear he wasn’t going anywhere. Warming up the streets with his Pharrell Williams-produced single, “Dead Fresh,” Baby kicked off the rollout […]
item.content:encoded:
Lil Baby is back to remind the world that he’s far from finished.

As conversation began about whether the Atlanta rapper was starting to lose his grip on the rap game, Wham made it clear he wasn’t going anywhere. Warming up the streets with his Pharrell Williams-produced single, “Dead Fresh,” Baby kicked off the rollout with a colorful music video and a record that sparked mixed reactions from frans.

Last December, Baby dropped The Leaks, following a similar rollout strategy. Before releasing the project, he gave fans a taste of what was coming with the single “Mrs. Trendsetter.” Now, nearly a year later, he’s back with his first project of 2027, FRESH.

To celebrate the release, Baby teamed up with popular Atlanta wingspot American Deli for a special collaboration. The restaurant is giving away free “WHAM Wings” to the first 500 fans who pull up to his pop-up this Saturday, November 7.

With a relatively short feature list that includes Future, Young Thug, and Rylo Rodriguez, Wham appears ready to let his music do the talking. Rather than relying on a lengthy list of guest appearances, the Atlanta rapper is putting his own story front and center.

Check out some of our early takeaways from Lil Baby’s FRESH album below.

item.title: Lil Durk’s Attorneys Blast Fed Prosecutors’ “Hypocrisy”
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: Judge delays bond decision for Lil Durk as prosecutors oppose his release despite murder-for-hire acquittal, citing contraband violations and rule-breaking in jail.
item.content:encoded:
The hopes Lil Durk had of getting out of prison ahead of a second rackteering trial next year were put on hold on Wednesday (November 4), and his lawyers are upset with prosecutors from the federal government aiming to keep the rapper in jail despite him being acquitted of a murder-for-hire charge earlier this year.

The prosecution and the defense, along with Lil Durk, appeared before Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald in court. Attorneys Drew Findling, Brian Steel and Marissa Goldberg presented a bond package proposal that included letters of support from known celebrities such as Jay-Z and J. Cole, as well as all of Lil Durk’s future music royalties as well as his mother’s home as collateral.

The prosecution wasn’t swayed by the appeal, alleging that Lil Durk aka Durk Banks was guilty of concealing contraband while incarcerated at the Los Angeles Metropolitan Detention Center. They claim that Lil Durk acquired an Apple Watch and hid it in a body cavity, making hundreds of phone calls before confiscating it, according to Taylor Parise of LA Magazine.

Prosecutors argued that Lil Durk was constantly breaking rules, leading to him being placed in solitary confinement. They also alleged that he was using his celebrity connections to manipulate the court, claiming that celebrities who attended the August trial like Ye and Machine Gun Kelly were allowed to cut the lint to the courtroom and that Lil Durk’s team paid protesters outside of the courthouse.

Lil Durk’s attorneys hotly contested the accusations, blasting the government’s resistance to the bond proposal. “here is a little bit of hypocrisy here. The Government is unwilling to accept…I’m embarrassed for them,” said Findling as reported by journalist Michael Blackshire. “Those were well-informed jurors. The statements in this case pale in comparison to PW1 & PW2.”

item.content:encoded:
Fat Joe is brought his legendary catalog to NPR’s Tiny Desk for a performance fans won’t want to miss.

From his early Terror Squad days to the records that helped an era of New York Hip-Hop, Fat Joe has no shortage of hits to pull from. His Tiny Desk appearance gives longtime fans a chance to revisit those records.

The New York MC announced the episode on social media, and it officially dropped today. It’s another big moment for Joey, who has been having a strong year thanks to the success of his podcast with Jadakiss, The Joe & Jada Show.

He’s also been feeding his core fan base with new music. Back in August, Fat Joe released his album Organized Crime, featuring Pusha T, Yung Miami, Jadakiss, and several other artists. The project was a breath of fresh air and a reminder that Joey hasn’t lost a step when it comes to the bars.

Now, fans get to celebrate his decades-long rap career through the Tiny Desk series. With a catalog packed with classic, putting together the perfect setlist was no easy task, but he nailed it. From the Bronx to the NPR office, Fat Joe had plenty of hits to choose from.

item.title: New ‘GTA 6’ Launch Photos Confirms Kodak Black Is in The Game
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Rockstar Games confirms Kodak Black appears in GTA 6, releasing new launch photos ahead of the November 19 release date.
item.content:encoded:
Rockstar Games continues to build hype for GTA 6 and just released a plethora of photos, and one of them confirms that Kodak Black will be in the highly anticipated video game.

After the news that pre-load for GTA 6 begins on Nov.10 and the massive amount of disk space the game will require, we now have a new batch of launch photos to gawk over, including one featuring Kodak Black.

Black’s involvement in the game should come as no surprise, since he is a Miami resident and the game is returning to Leonida and Vice City, Rockstar Games’ fictional take on Florida and its vacation hot spot.

Kodak Black, alongside other Miami Hip-Hop legends Trina and Trick Daddy, will also feature their music in the game, with the Slip N’ Slide duo hosting one of the many radio stations you can tune into while committing all sorts of crimes.

The rest of the images show more of the game’s main protagonists, Jason and Lucia, as well as other characters we’ll meet and get familiar with when we finally hit start on November 19.

The GTA franchise is best known for satirizing epic moments in pop culture, current events, and popular figures, but this is one of the few times the actual person is portrayed in the game, with Black’s involvement basically confirmed.

Problematic streamer Neon, or someone who looks like him, also appeared in the extended look we got of the game that premiered on Netflix before it hit Rockstar Games’ YouTube account.

These photos are probably the last thing we will get from Rockstar Games up until GTA 6’s release. We do wonder if we will see more familiar faces in the game.

We will have to wait until Nov.19 to see; until then, you can check out the latest photos from the game below.

item.title: Stevie Wonder’s Ex Says He’s A Terrible Landlord And Wants Him To Fix Her House
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Stevie Wonder's ex-girlfriend fights eviction, demanding he repair their decades-old rent-free home plagued by leaks, holes, and peeling paint.
item.content:encoded:
Stevie Wonder’s former girlfriend, whom he once considered marrying, is back in court fighting the singer’s effort to evict her from a Los Angeles home she says he promised her decades ago. And apparently, while Wonder may be a musical genius, his former flame believes he leaves a lot to be desired as a landlord.

According to TMZ, Carmen Efferson filed a response in court Tuesday denying claims made by the “My Cherie Amour” singer and asking a judge not to throw her out of the property. But Efferson isn’t just fighting to keep a roof over her head. She also wants Wonder ordered to fix the house, which she claims has been neglected for years.

And based on the list of alleged problems, this isn’t exactly a case of somebody complaining about a leaky faucet.

Efferson claims the property has “damp or leaking ceilings or walls, holes in the walls/floors/carpet, falling plaster or peeling paint, defective/leaking plumbing, and many more issues,” TMZ reports. She wants the repairs made as soon as possible.

Wonder’s original filing sought to remove Efferson from the home, where she says she has lived since July 1988. The arrangement, according to the filing, was based on a verbal agreement rather than a formal lease. And the rent? Absolutely nothing. Efferson reportedly has been living there rent-free for nearly four decades.

Wonder argues that the agreement has run its course and that it’s time for his former girlfriend to move on. He also claims he has tried to send people to inspect the property, including an insurance inspector, but Efferson has refused to allow them inside.

A source close to Efferson told TMZ she was blindsided by the lawsuit. The source also said Efferson has told friends that Wonder promised her the house.

Which brings us to the rather awkward question at the center of this whole mess: What exactly was promised, and what did both parties understand that promise to mean?

For now, Wonder wants his former girlfriend out, while Efferson wants to stay and have the house repaired. It’s a messy situation involving an ex, an alleged decades-old promise and a landlord-tenant dispute that has somehow turned into a courtroom showdown.

The man who gave us “Isn’t She Lovely” is now apparently asking a judge to decide whether his former love has overstayed her welcome.

item.title: Lil Durk’s Bond Verdict Delayed, For Now
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: On Wednesday (November 4), Lil Durk attended the hearing to determine if he should be let out on bond before another racketeering trial next year. The presiding judge, however, didn’t issue a verdict as he opted to review filings from the prosecution and the defense. According to reports, Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald made his ruling […]
item.content:encoded:
On Wednesday (November 4), Lil Durk attended the hearing to determine if he should be let out on bond before another racketeering trial next year. The presiding judge, however, didn’t issue a verdict as he opted to review filings from the prosecution and the defense.

According to reports, Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald made his ruling after a two-hour hearing which began at 2:30 local time. Lil Durk’s attorneys argued that the rapper has spent over two years in jail, and pointed to his willingness to put future music royalties up as bond.

The prosecution, however, disagreed. Assistant U.S. Attorney Daniel Weiner argued that Lil Durk had “absolutely no respect for authority”, dismissing the endorsements from Jay-Z, J. Cole and other celebrities he received while adding he would be investigated for allegedly introducing contraband into the Metropolitan Detention Center in Los Angeles, California.

Judge Fitzgerald also took into consideration the prosecution’s allegation that Lil Durk would be a flight risk. According to Billboard, the “All My Life” rapper made an attempt to flee to Dubai before he was arrested in 2024. Lil Durk was acquited in August of murder-for-hire in the shooting of Quando Rondo at a gas station in L.A. in 2022. His cousin, Saviay’a “Lul Pab” Robinson was killed in the incident.

“It’s a question of psychology,” Judge Fitzgerald asked. “Would he flee?” He noted that Lil Durk has more of an incentive to let the system play out, noting that” the acquittals really do change the calculation a great deal.” He promised to review all of the filings and deliver a verdict but didn’t specify a time.

That means that Lil Durk will remain incarcerated while awaiting his Violent Crimes in Aid of Racketeering Activity (VICAR) trial, which is set to take place in August 2027. Prosecutors are arguing that Lil Durk operated his Only The Family (OTF) label like a violent gang, citing the Quando Rondo shooting as well as another shooting in Atlanta, Georgia in 2019 and another murder in Chicago in 2022.

The prosecution also signaled that they were willing to speed up the process to have that VICAR trial take place earlier than its established date. Lil Durk’s attorneys have argued that using the statute is “incredibly weak” and anything related to the Quando Rondo shooting should be thrown out.

item.content:encoded:
Diddy has remained at the top of 50 Cent’s troll list for quite some time, and it doesn’t look like that’s changing anytime soon.

Rain, sleet, or snow, 50 Cent is going to find a way to get a Diddy joke off. On November 4, the Bad Boy mogul celebrated his 57th birthday. However, with his legal troubles keeping him behind bars, this year’s celebration looked a little different. Of course, 50 made sure to seize the opportunity, seemingly trolling Diddy with a birthday message of his own.

“Happy 57th B Day Diddy, wishing you many more. LOL.”

That “LOL” says it all. The New York rapper clearly couldn’t resist getting a joke off at his longtime rivals expense.

This has become a recurring tradition for Curtis Jackson. Last year, on Diddy’s 56th birthday, 50 also took a shot at the music mogul, writing:

“Told you he alright. Got his appeal going, Diddy good! Happy birthday LOL.”

He also shared an AI-generated video of a man resembling Diddy dancing in a prison yard to “Mo Money Mo Problems.”

Most recently, Diddy was reportedly housed at Fort Dix in New Jersey after spending an extended period in general population. His team previously addressed concerns about his safety, saying that his well-being remains a priority. 

“His safety and well-being are always important to us, but we have no specific reason to believe he is at risk. We hope he can continue serving his time safely and without unnecessary disruption.”

While Diddy continues serving his sentence, 50 Cent clearly isn’t letting an opportunity to troll him pass by, even on his birthday,

item.title: Diddy’s Lawyers Want Nearly $600K In Unpaid Fees. And They’re Coming To Collect
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Sean “Diddy” Combs’ civil lawyers want their money and it’s not a little bit. According to Complex, Diddy’s civil lawyers are looking for $581,893.75 for past work that they claimed that they weren’t paid for. An October 30 letter sent from Sher Tremonte LLP to Judge John P. Cronan and viewed by Complex, is asking […]
item.content:encoded:
Sean “Diddy” Combs’ civil lawyers want their money and it’s not a little bit.

According to Complex, Diddy’s civil lawyers are looking for $581,893.75 for past work that they claimed that they weren’t paid for.

An October 30 letter sent from Sher Tremonte LLP to Judge John P. Cronan and viewed by Complex, is asking the court to put a lien on the amount in Combs’ defamation case against Courtney Burgess, Ariel Mitchell, and Nexstar.

If Combs wins any money from settlement or judgments against the defendants that the lien could be entitled to that money.

Michael Tremonte backed up the nearly $582,000 figure under oath, submitting a declaration and a sealed spreadsheet detailing the firm’s hours and billing rates. The firm says it didn’t include individual invoices because its work for Combs stretched across dozens of legal matters, making the billing a little more complicated than one giant receipt.

This latest money grab is part of an increasingly ugly breakup between Combs and the attorneys who once represented him. Sher Tremonte moved to withdraw as Diddy’s counsel in September, saying Combs was more than six months behind on payments and that there had been a “total breakdown in cooperation and communication.”

Judge Cronan approved the firm’s withdrawal and granted it a retaining lien on Combs’ case files while the firm documented what it was owed.

Combs sees the entire break up differently and accuses his former lawyers of overcharging him and running up bills he never approved.

“I made the decision to switch lawyers because I won’t let anyone take advantage of me by overcharging me and running up bills that were never approved,” he said in a September statement to NBC News.

Tremonte has denied those allegations, telling NBC News that “any suggestion that we overcharged him is simply false.”

And because apparently one nearly half-million-dollar legal bill wasn’t enough, this latest demand comes just weeks after Combs was ordered to pay NBCUniversal and its co-defendants $477,700.50 in legal fees after losing his defamation lawsuit over the documentary Diddy: The Making of a Bad Boy.

That award was ordered October 6 by Justice Phaedra F. Perry-Bond, according to People.

Now Combs has another legal tab to worry about, and this one comes from the people who were supposed to be helping him fight his legal battles.

Judge Cronan still has to determine whether Sher Tremonte is entitled to the full amount and whether the firm gets its requested lien.

item.title: XBOX Series X-Bite Will Give One Lucky Gamer A Very Unique Way To Play ‘GTA 6’
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Tuesday, XBOX announced it will be giving one lucky gamer a chance to win a 1-of-1 console called the XBOX Series X-Bite. This fully functional console is definitely on the wild side, being that it lives inside a 5-foot alligator.
item.content:encoded:
PlayStation 5 might be the best way to experience GTA 6, according to Rockstar Games, but the XBOX Series X-Bite will be the most unique and unusual way to play the highly anticipated game.

Tuesday, XBOX announced it will be giving one lucky gamer a chance to win a 1-of-1 console called the XBOX Series X-Bite. This fully functional console is definitely on the wild side, being that it lives inside a 5-foot alligator.

The console is only visible through the glowing green Xbox Nexus logo cut into the gator’s scales.

The XBOX wireless controller also stands out with a bite mark, and as a nice added touch, the controller rests comfortably in the alligator’s mouth.

The exclamation on the console is the Xbox-green irises and Nexus-inspired pupils, which is a very nice touch.

Now, this console isn’t being pushed as an official tie-in to the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, because PlayStation has the exclusive marketing agreement, but based on the music played in the background video revealing XBOX Series X-Bite, and the setting in a fictional place based on Florida, which is known for being the home of gators, it’s hard to think the game didn’t inspire it.

If you are eager to get this interesting collector’s item in your gaming room, you have to follow these simple rules to enter the contest:

  1. Follow @XBOX on your platform of choice.
  2. Repost the designated XBOX sweepstakes post.
  3. Manually add #XbiteSweepstakes to your repost.

Gamers are weighing in on the XBOX Series X-Bite; you can see their reactions below. Oh, and of course, good luck.

item.title: Lil Baby Opens Up About His Political Growth And Why Voting Matters
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Lil Baby chopped it up with Posted On The Corner’s Incognito to discuss the importance of voting and how his perspective on politics over the years. On Election Day, the Atlanta rapper was on the frontlines, encouraging young people to make their voices heard. Wham has made it a point to use his platform to […]
item.content:encoded:
Lil Baby chopped it up with Posted On The Corner’s Incognito to discuss the importance of voting and how his perspective on politics over the years.

On Election Day, the Atlanta rapper was on the frontlines, encouraging young people to make their voices heard. Wham has made it a point to use his platform to influence the next generation, urging them to make informed decisions and stand up for that they believe in.

His commitment to speaking out was evident when he released The Bigger Picture in 2020 amid nationwide protests and growing calls for social change. The powerful record addressed police brutality and racial injustice, showing how the rapper was willing to use his voice to speak on issues affecting his community.

During a visit to Hot 107.9 in Atlanta, Baby opened up to Incognito about his political growth and realizing that encouraging people to vote can make a difference.

“Only thing I can do is I hope that me advising people to go out and vote make a difference. Every vote counts and I was one of the people that actually believed that voting don’t do nothing for us. But the more I grow and the more I understand politics and the community it actually does matter.”

Along with encouraging young people to get involved in the political process, Lil Baby is gearing up to release his next studio album, Fresh, on Friday. The project is led by “Dead Fresh,” produced by Pharrell Williams.

As Lil Baby continues to grow as an artist a voice in his community, he hopes his message inspire the next generation to get involved and recognize the power they hold at the polls.

item.title: Timbaland Sues Former Managers For $15 Million
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: Hit-making producer Timbaland is going to court against his former managers, filing a lawsuit alleging that they treated him like “a piggy bank” in the documents. In the lawsuit filed last Friday (October 30) in Los Angeles, California, Timbaland accused former manager Gary Marella claiming that he “stole millions in unauthorized commissions, fees, and reimbursements” […]
item.content:encoded:
Hit-making producer Timbaland is going to court against his former managers, filing a lawsuit alleging that they treated him like “a piggy bank” in the documents.

In the lawsuit filed last Friday (October 30) in Los Angeles, California, Timbaland accused former manager Gary Marella claiming that he “stole millions in unauthorized commissions, fees, and reimbursements” and “falsified financial records” to hide his actions.

He also alleged that former business manager Bruce Seckendorf incurred large tax penalties by not paying federal taxes, all while paying himself and Marella millions in fees. The situation almost left Timbaland’s house in foreclosure in addition to the penalties being levied.

“This is not a case about ordinary business losses or bookkeeping errors,” Timbaland’s lawyers wrote in the lawsuit. “Defendants used their entrusted authority to enrich themselves and others, conceal financial misconduct, and deplete Timbaland’s valuable assets.”

Timbaland was managed by Marella for close to a decade, with the latter overseeing the iconic producer behind songs such as Jay-Z’s “Big Pimpin” and Missy Elliott’s “Sock It To Me” as he sold his catalog to Hipnosis Songs Fund in 2019 and his stake in the popular livestream rap and R&B battle series Verzuz.

Their split began in August, when DJ E Feezy filed a wrongful termination lawsuit against Timbaland in a Florida court. Timbaland in turn blamed Marella, claiming his financial impropriety was responsible for E Feezy being let go and claiming he fired Marella a year earlier. Timbaland, aka Timothy Zachary Mosley, alleged that “Defendants knew where the money went. Mosley did not.”

Timbaland also claimed Marella took funds from Beatclub, their joint venture launched in 2021 to help producers sell and market their beats to interested parties, and“treated Mosley as a piggy bank to repair the problems he created.”

Marella denied the accusations. “When I began managing Tim in 2017, long after he had produced his biggest hits, he was already in a bad financial place,” Marella said in a statemetn. “His financial problems did not begin with me. I came in to help rebuild his business. Over approximately nine years after I started working with Tim, we generated roughly $75 million in business.”

item.title: Plies Gets Emotional While Praising Black Women For Showing Up To The Voting Polls
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Did somebody say Plies for president? The people’s champ had a special message for our Black queens after seeing them show up to the polls on Election Day. As voters across the nation made their voices heard, the Buss It Baby rapper headed to his local polling place and exercised his right to vote. However, […]
item.content:encoded:
Did somebody say Plies for president? The people’s champ had a special message for our Black queens after seeing them show up to the polls on Election Day.

As voters across the nation made their voices heard, the Buss It Baby rapper headed to his local polling place and exercised his right to vote. However, his experience at the voting precinct turned into something deeper than just casting a ballot.

In a heartwarming video, the Florida legend praise the Black women he was showing up to the polls, expressing how much it meant to witness their dedication to making a difference.

“All women in general are amazing but its something about my sista’s man, I just wanna tell y’all. Walking in that place and seeing y’all give y’all services, that sh*t really just chokes me up. It just reminded me how amazing y’all really are, how caring y’all really are, how invested y’all really are, and just how much y’all just always on the frontline.”

Fighting back tears as he delivered his message, Plies took a moment to uplift the Black women who continue to show up and make their voices heard. His emotional reaction highlighted the impact of seeing women actively participate in the democratic process and stand up for what they believe in.

The rapper has never been shy about sharing his thoughts, but this moment showed a more vulnerable side of the Florida legend. Judging his heartfelt words, he wanted to make sure his Black queens knew their efforts did not go unnoticed.

item.title: It’s Really Happening: Rockstar Games Drops ‘GTA 6’s Pre-Load Info
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Mark your calendars gamers: Rockstar Games announced that pre-loading for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S|X will begin Tuesday, November 10, at midnight local time in your respective time zone.
item.content:encoded:
Can you believe it? GTA 6 is literally just days away, and now we know when you can actually pre-load what is easily one of the most anticipated video games of all time.

Mark your calendars gamers: Rockstar Games announced that pre-loading for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S|X will begin Tuesday, November 10, at midnight local time in your respective time zone.

Code-in-box versions, aka no physical discs in the box, but you get a cool case, should be available at retailers beginning November 12.

The video game studio also revealed that the pre-load file will require 212 GB, so make sure you clear that space and tackle your backlog before you start pre-loading the game.

On Nov.19, Rockstar Games also announced that an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida will be available as a free digital download on the official site.

Well, isn’t that lovely.

As expected, gaming social media is beside itself as we inch closer to GTA 6’s long-awaited release day, because they truly thought they would never see it, and are reacting to the game’s significantly large install size. Still, for some, to quote Shannon Sharpe, “that ain’t no problem, that ain’t no problem,” as games will be deleted to make room for GTA 6.

“I’ll delete any game I’m currently playing for Grand Theft Auto 6, even if I’m right before the final boss,” one post read on social media.

Another post stated, “WE MADE IT TO THE PRE-LOAD PHASE.”

At a time when the news in the video game industry feels bleak, we finally have something to be happy about with GTA 6’s release.

You can see more reactions below.

item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Content creator Marcel Johnson has reportedly passed away, according to his wife, Taylor Johnson. After a long battle with cancer, Johnson has sadly transitioned. Throughout his journey, he used his platform to document his fight and keep his followers updated. In one heartbreaking video, he explained to his 4-year-old child that his chemotherapy and immunotherapy […]
item.content:encoded:
Content creator Marcel Johnson has reportedly passed away, according to his wife, Taylor Johnson.

After a long battle with cancer, Johnson has sadly transitioned. Throughout his journey, he used his platform to document his fight and keep his followers updated. In one heartbreaking video, he explained to his 4-year-old child that his chemotherapy and immunotherapy treatments had not been working.

In a social media post, Marcel’s wife, Taylor Johnson, shared the heartbreaking news of her husband’s passing after his long battle with cancer:

“November 2 2026 @ 445pm. I lost a whole entire half of me. He fought so hard for so long. He was so tired & exhausted & in so much pain. Yesterday the only words Marcel said all day were to me & Dedric and it was “I’m ready to go” and that was in the morning. He still fought to hang on all day so we just got a bit more time. I truly don’t even have words right now. I feel like this can’t be real life. How can this be real f*cking life. I thought I was going to wake up and he was still going to be here beside me. I love him with my whole entire being and life will absolutely never ever be the same.”

Our thoughts and prayers go out to Marcel Johnson’s friends and family.

item.title: Lil Durk Given Solitary Confinement Before Bond Hearing
item.dc:creator: Christopher Smith
item.description: Rapper Lil Durk has been placed in solitary confinement at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Los Angeles, California, days before he’s set to have a bond hearing and shortly after he was acquitted in a murder-for-hire trial. According to reporting from TMZ, Lil Durk was sent to the Special Housing Unit last Friday (October 30), […]
item.content:encoded:
Rapper Lil Durk has been placed in solitary confinement at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Los Angeles, California, days before he’s set to have a bond hearing and shortly after he was acquitted in a murder-for-hire trial.

According to reporting from TMZ, Lil Durk was sent to the Special Housing Unit last Friday (October 30), which was confirmed by Bureau of Prisons secretary Jose Rojas for “talking back.”

Sources close to the situation said that Lil Durk’s cell was “constantly searched” since he was acquitted on September 11 on all five counts of stalking and murder-for-hire that he faced. When he asked prison guards about all the searches, Lil Durk was reprimanded and then placed in solitary confinement.

This is his second stint in the unit – his attorney, Christy O’Connor revealed in January that Lil Durk was given solitary confinement for over 130 days after an Apple Watch was found in his possession. He protested the conditions, with O’Connor arguing that “the deleterious effects of extended solitary confinement on an inmate’s psychological well-being are well-documented.”

Lil Durk, aka Durk Devontay Banks, was set to go before Judge Michael W. Fitzgerald on Wednesday (November 4). Sony has offered an appearance bond of $1 million, with the “Survived The Storm” rapper also offering touring income, publishing revenue and future royalties on his music as security against him violating the bond.

The rapper is set to go to trial on August 30, 2027 on a murder in aid of racketeering and a firearm offense. The court has already received letters of support from Jay-Z, J.Cole, Fanatics founder MIchael Rubin and former Illinois state attorney Kim Foxx. 

Notably, the mother of Saviay’a “Lul Pab” Robinson also stated to the court that she wouldn’t object if the court decided to grant bond. Robinson was killed in the 2022 drive-by shooting at the Beverly Center mall, which Lil Durk had been alleged to be involved in before his acquittal.

item.content:encoded:
FlyySoulja, one half of the Island Boys, was reportedly hospitalized following an alleged overdose, according to TMZ.

The Florida influencer was reportedly to a Miami trauma unit after the incident. Reports claim he had a combination of cocaine, benzodiazepines, and Percocet in his system. The alleged overdose occurred on Thursday, October 29, as Soulja was celebrating the purchase of a new car and condo.

FlyySoulja has previously opened up about his personal struggles, revealing thqt he was involuntary placed under a mental health evaluation in November 2025. He has also been vocal about his history of substance abuse, sharing his experiences with sobriety over the years.

In January 2026, Flyy reportedly entered rehab of an undisclosed amount of time. His previous struggles have raised concerns as reports of his latest hospitalization circulate online.

As of now, neither FlyySoulja nor his team has released an official statement regarding the reported incident. 

This story is developing.

item.title: ‘SNL’ Mocks Nicki Minaj’s Trump Love Affair
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: SNL mocked Nicki Minaj's political alignment with Trump, joking that her career suffered from the partnership despite her massive chart success.
item.content:encoded:
The jokes write themselves. Literally.

And apparently, so does the material when Nicki Minaj decides that hitching her wagon to Donald Trump is a good career move.

Saturday Night Live spent part of its Halloween cold open Saturday (Oct. 31) doing what comedians everywhere have been doing since Minaj decided to become MAGA’s newest celebrity mascot: wondering just how much more ridiculous this whole thing could get.

Cast member Saidah Belo-Osagie popped up near the end of the sketch playing Minaj, after James Austin Johnson’s Trump had been busy patting himself on the back for attracting the rapper to his political circus.

“Trump’s out here killing it,” Belo-Osagie’s Minaj declared, “and by it, I mean my career.”

Ouch. Somebody check on the Barbz.

The sketch also floated Minaj as Trump’s next White House press secretary, which would be hilarious if the idea hadn’t actually been entertained by people inside the administration.

The parody was inspired by Minaj’s Oct. 25 appearance at Trump’s rally in Port Huron, Michigan, where she traveled aboard Air Force One with the president and publicly backed Republican candidates Mike Rogers and John James ahead of Tuesday’s (Nov. 3) midterm elections.

During the rally, Trump invited Minaj to address the crowd and made a series of comments about her appearance. Because apparently, the president of the United States has graduated from governing to hosting a very uncomfortable episode of Love Connection.

The press secretary jokes weren’t entirely pulled out of thin air, either. A Trump staffer reportedly floated Minaj for the position during the Air Force One trip, and Trump later told The Benny Show that it was “a good idea,” adding, “I’m gonna think about that.”

Minaj, meanwhile, has embraced her new political bestie, declaring she is “not going anywhere” after Trump referred to her as his “favorite.”

Well, that’s certainly one way to secure an endorsement. Another way might be releasing an album, but apparently, we’re trying something different. The Halloween cold open itself was built around a trip through a budget haunted attraction, with Grace Reiter and Jeremy Culhane playing a couple on a date and Kenan Thompson serving as their Grim Reaper guide.

Then came Tom Hanks as David S. Pumpkins, the wonderfully bizarre character he introduced on SNL in 2016, accompanied by his dancing skeleton sidekicks Mikey Day and former cast member Bobby Moynihan.

Before the character could get too comfortable, Johnson’s Trump interrupted the proceedings.

“I’ll save you four minutes: he keeps popping up and confusing people on the ride. The end,” he told the audience before comparing himself to Pumpkins: “We both appeared in 2016, we’re both very loud, very orange.”

He then pivoted to complaining about Republican polling ahead of the midterms before Belo-Osagie’s Minaj made her entrance to deliver the evening’s most obvious punchline.

Minaj has not publicly addressed the sketch.

For context, the rapper isn’t exactly some random celebrity looking for a second act. She is one of the most successful artists in Billboard chart history. In 2018, she became the first woman to log 100 entries on the Billboard Hot 100, and she holds the record for the most Hot 100 top 10s among female rappers. In 2020, she and Doja Cat became the first female rap duo to top the Hot 100 with the remix of “Say So.”

That’s quite a résumé to put on the table just to end up being a punchline in a Trump sketch.

The episode was hosted by Obsession star Inde Navarrette, making her SNL hosting debut, with Gracie Abrams serving as the musical guest for her second appearance on the show. Abrams performed following the Oct. 29 release of her new single, “Here You Come, There You Go,” and ahead of her Look at My Life arena tour, which kicks off Dec. 2 in Denver in support of her third album, Daughter From Hell.

But let’s be honest: The night’s biggest surprise wasn’t David S. Pumpkins returning from the dead.

It was Nicki Minaj discovering that the quickest way to get back into the headlines might be to become the court jester of the MAGA movement.

item.title: 2 Chainz & Keith Lee Go Back-And-Forth About A Negative Review Lee Gave To 2 Chainz Restaurant
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Over the years Keith Lee has made quite the name for himself reviewing restaurants and independent eateries and helping put some overlooked establishments on the map, but a bad review for Esco Restaurant & Tapas left rapper 2 Chainz with a bad taste in his mouth as that happened to be his own food joint. […]
item.content:encoded:
Over the years Keith Lee has made quite the name for himself reviewing restaurants and independent eateries and helping put some overlooked establishments on the map, but a bad review for Esco Restaurant & Tapas left rapper 2 Chainz with a bad taste in his mouth as that happened to be his own food joint.

Now all this time later the two men were actually in each other’s presence along with the likes of comedians Mojo Brookzz, and Desi Banks for Kirk Franklin’s Den of Kings round table in which each guest opened up about their personal journey to fame and what it took for them to get here.

After Keith Lee opened up about having social anxiety and overcoming it to become a TikTok star, 2 Chainz brought up how Keith gave a negative review to his Esco Restaurant & Tapas eatery and though he said “I really can’t judge it because it’s your opinion,” Chainz obviously felt a ways about having one of the most influential food critics on social media say bad things about his establishment saying “Who is buddy?!”

Lee for his part defended his stance on the negative review explaining that it has more to do with the overall experience than just the flavor of the food saying “I never come from a perspective of a expert or the perspective of a chef. I come from the perspective of somebody who is a consumer of Black community. That’s a part of Black community. Somebody who want the advancement of the Black community.”

Continuing to build on his point, Lee explained that celebrity perks often lead to better dining experiences than those of the everyday man, “If you Mojo Brookzz, you 2 Chainz, you Desi Banks, you Kirk, if you go in, you going to get a completely different experience than if my mama go in or my wife go in or if anybody in the crowd go in.”

Recalling how he once sent his mother-in-law to several restaurants in Atlanta and she couldn’t get serviced anywhere, Lee said “I go in, table ready right now.”

While 2 Chainz pushed back and said those celebrity perks just come with the fam, Lee’s point was made and we can’t help but find it weird to see Chainz all up in his feelings about a bad restaurant review. That too comes with the restaurant game.

Can’t win em all, Chainz.

Check out 2 Chainz and Keith Lee exchange opinions around the 16-minute mark and let us know your thoughts about this particular conversation in the comments section below.

item.title: Stadium Status: Kanye West Breaks Record For The Highest Attended Rap Concert
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Kanye West just pulled off the unthinkable during his latest show in Houston. With 80,210 attendees at NRG Stadium, Ye reportedly broke the record for the largest attendance at a single Hip-Hop concert. The milestone surpasses his previous record of 74,000 tickets sold at SoFi Stadium in April. Just another reason for Ye to pop […]
item.content:encoded:
Kanye West just pulled off the unthinkable during his latest show in Houston.

With 80,210 attendees at NRG Stadium, Ye reportedly broke the record for the largest attendance at a single Hip-Hop concert. The milestone surpasses his previous record of 74,000 tickets sold at SoFi Stadium in April.

Just another reason for Ye to pop it.

Although this isn’t the most-attended concert of all time, it’s still a. major milestone for Hip-Hop. That distinction belongs to Zach Bryan, whose 2025 concert at Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor drew 112,408 attendees. Still, Ye’s latest achievement proves that his influence and ability to bring fans together remain undeniable. 

The Chicago rapper put on a show packed with timeless records, giving fans the they’ve come to know and love. The crowd got to hear “Can’t Tell Me Nothing,” “Runaway,” “Touch The Sky,” and plenty more.

Ye also brought out some special guests, including Playboi Carti, North West, and André Troutman, adding even more star power to the historic night. The surprise appearances gave fans even more reasons to remember the Houston show long after the lights went down.

There were also notable names spotted in the crowd supporting Ye. Drake and Travis Scott were both in attendance, making for an interesting sight considering their complicated history with the Chicago rapper.

With a record-breaking Houston show behind him, Ye isn’t slowing down anytime soon. He’s scheduled to continue his run with performances in Dallas on November 7 and Phoenix on November 21.

If Houston was indication, Ye’s remaining shows could bring even more memorable moments for fans.
